title: Main screen and split-screen FM usability
summary: This topic centers on main-screen interface use, with a few clear comments about climate-control interaction and split-screen media display but many fragments that are too incomplete or off-topic to show a consistent sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention enjoyment unrelated to the screen itself and a general statement that the car is not the main issue, so concrete praise about the main screen is limited.

negative.summary: Negative feedback points to frustration that HVAC controls rely on the screen instead of physical knobs.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments discuss the main screen, electronics learning, and split-screen or information-display limitations, but they are too fragmentary or inconsistently scoped to assign a clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a clear sentiment readout for this topic.
